'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***[[October 2024 Aitou airstrike]]
****At least 21 people are killed and eight others are injured when an [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]] hits an apartment building in the village of [[Aitou]] in [[North Lebanon|northern]] [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/israeli-strike-in-northern-lebanon-kills-at-least-18-people-far-from-hezbollah-s-main-strongholds-1.7073272 (CTV News)]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] say that they killed Muhammad Kamel Naim, the head of the anti-tank missile array of Hezbollah's elite [[Redwan Force]], in an airstrike in [[Nabatieh]], Lebanon. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-it-killed-head-of-elite-hezbollah-anti-tank-missile-array/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least four people are killed and dozens of others are severely injured when an [[Israel]]i airstrike hits a tent camp at a [[hospital]] in [[Deir al-Balah]] in the [[Gaza Strip]], causing the tents to catch fire. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/14/burned-and-charred-bodies-as-israel-hits-tents-at-central-gaza-hospital (Al Jazeera)]
***At least ten people are killed by Israeli [[artillery]] fire at a food distribution centre in the [[Jabalia refugee camp]] in northern Gaza. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5y5zy1vvmlo (BBC News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Russian forces]] claim that they took the village of [[Levadne, Zaporizhzhia Oblast|Levadne]] in [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/russia-says-it-seized-village-in-ukraine-s-zaporizhzhia-region-/7821473.html (Voice of America)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences]]
**This year's [[Nobel Prize]] in [[economics]] is awarded to [[Turkish Americans|Turkish-American]] economist [[Daron Acemoglu]], [[British Americans|British-American]] economist [[Simon Johnson (economist)|Simon Johnson]], and British economist [[James A. Robinson]] for their studies "of [[institutional economics|how institutions are formed]] and affect prosperity". [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/10/14/business/nobel-economics.html? (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/economic-sciences/2024/press-release/ (Nobel Prize)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twelve people are killed and 33 others are injured when a bus carrying students from [[Galala University]] overturns in [[Al Galala]], [[Suez Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. [https://apnews.com/article/egypt-bus-crash-suez-university-students-7b69d1972f90cd514d558c6d6c8a0ddf (AP)]
*One person is killed and 23 others are injured when an [[NJ Transit]] [[River Line (NJ Transit)|River Line]] train collides with a tree that had fallen onto the tracks in [[Mansfield Township, Warren County, New Jersey|Mansfield Township]], [[New Jersey]], [[United States]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/operator-dies-and-passengers-injured-as-new-jersey-commuter-train-hits-a-piece-of-a-tree-1.7073448 (CTV News)]

'''Law and crime''' 
*[[Gaza war protests in the United States]] 
**Over 200 [[Palestinian nationalism|pro-Palestinian demonstrators]] against [[Gaza war protests in the United States|American involvement]] in [[War crimes in the Gaza war|Israeli attacks on civilians]] in the [[Gaza Strip]], many from [[Jewish Voice for Peace]], are arrested outside of the [[New York Stock Exchange Building|New York Stock Exchange]] for attempting to block it. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/dozens-pro-palestinian-protesters-arrested-outside-new-york-stock-exchange-2024-10-14/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Papua New Guinea Defence Force]] shoot six people, killing one, during an operation against illegal mining near [[Porgera Gold Mine]] in [[Enga Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]]. [https://www.benarnews.org/english/news/pacific/png-porgera-shooting-10142024010357.html (BenarNews)]
*[[National Guard (Mexico)|Mexican National Guard]] finds the [[decapitated]] bodies of five men on a road in [[Ojuelos de Jalisco]], [[Jalisco]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/14/five-beheaded-bodies-found-next-to-road-in-mexicos-jalisco (Al Jazeera)]

'''Science and technology'''
